task.title: Add governed LLM source-change proposal workflow
task.summary_zh: 新增 SourceChangeProposal model/store/API，讓 LLM 只能提出 add/disable/retire/replace/change_schedule/request_quote 草稿，不能直接改 source registry。
acceptance: Add SourceChangeProposal model and JSONL dev store
Add proposal APIs for list create submit approve reject apply
LLM adapter can write only draft proposals and never mutates registries directly
Approved proposal applies through audited registry lifecycle command
Rejected proposal has no side effects
Approval rules distinguish public paid credentialed and strategy seed sources
task.next: Owner finalized: Claude2 review approved all 6 acceptance criteria. 61 tests pass in test_proposal_governance.py. Design invariant §14.5 enforced — LLM draft boundary is structural. PR #1230 merged into dev.

handoffs.message:
Implementation complete. PR #1230: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/1230

Deliverables:
- services/source_ingestion/registry/proposals.py: SourceChangeProposal model (immutable, lifecycle-enforced), ProposedSourceInfo, ProposalRisk, SourceChangeProposalStore (JSONL dev store). Design invariant §14.5 enforced: no code path can apply a proposal directly.
- services/source_ingestion/registry/llm_proposal_adapter.py: LLMSourceProposalAdapter — draft-only boundary for all 7 proposal types. No submit/approve/apply methods on the adapter.
- services/source_ingestion/registry/__init__.py: exports updated.
- services/source_ingestion/main.py: PROPOSAL_STORE_PATH, store/adapter init, 8 new routes (list/create/get proposals, llm-draft, submit/approve/reject/apply/retire actions).
- services/control-plane/bff/read_store.py: get_source_change_proposals() read-only from source-ingest service.
- services/control-plane/bff/main.py: GET /api/v1/research/source-change-proposals.
- services/source_ingestion/tests/test_proposal_governance.py: 61 tests covering model invariants, lifecycle, JSONL persistence, adapter isolation, registry non-mutation, full lifecycle flows.

Verification: python3 -m pytest services/source_ingestion/tests/test_proposal_governance.py services/source_ingestion/tests/test_registry_split.py — 124 passed, 0 failed.

Review changes requested: apply endpoint only marks proposals applied from caller-supplied change_ref instead of executing audited registry lifecycle command, and approve endpoint does not enforce approval rules for public/paid/credentialed/strategy seed sources. See PR #1230 comment https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/1230#issuecomment-4660669944

Implementation complete. PR #1230 open, all CI green. 61 proposal governance tests + 63 registry split tests pass (124 total). SourceChangeProposal model/store, LLMSourceProposalAdapter (draft-only boundary), 8 proposal API routes on source-ingest service, BFF read surface. Design invariant §14.5 enforced: LLM adapter cannot submit/approve/apply proposals directly.

Review not approved: approval rules are not enforced before approve/apply, invalid LLM risk entries are silently discarded, and generic create proposal IDs collide on repeated rationale. PR #1230 comment recorded: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/1230#issuecomment-4660774163. Validation run passed locally: python3 -m pytest services/source_ingestion/tests/test_proposal_governance.py services/source_ingestion/tests/test_registry_split.py -> 124 passed.

Implementation complete: SourceChangeProposal model/store, LLMSourceProposalAdapter, full lifecycle API (list/create/llm-draft/submit/approve/reject/apply/retire), and BFF read surface all landed in commit fdc138e8. 61/61 tests pass. LLM adapter enforces draft-only invariant; registry entries are never mutated by the adapter. Please review services/source_ingestion/registry/proposals.py, llm_proposal_adapter.py, main.py (proposal routes), and tests/test_proposal_governance.py.
Auto-reassigned review from Codex to Claude2 after repeated Codex terminal: Codex usage limit reached
Review approved: all 6 acceptance criteria met, §14.5 invariant structurally enforced, 61 tests pass. Returning to Claude for finalization.
